focus: Drama and intrigue first: the Luka Doncic ejected-fan story and the fan backlash, the Knicks-Karl-Anthony Towns extension and trade talk, Kings-Sabonis rift, and Nuggets-Jamal Murray trade debate. Biggest viral stories still get in: Steph Curry and the Warriors' win streak, and the Giannis vs Nick Young and Doc Rivers criticism. Every rumor is attributed and framed as a rumor. News decides exact stories each day, and no numbers or quotes are used unless they are in the sources.

long_videos.title_idea: The Trade Rumors Shaking Up the NBA Right Now
long_videos.angle: Rumor shape with a clue chain. Cover Knicks and Karl-Anthony Towns extension talks, Sabonis and the Kings rift, Jamal Murray and the Nuggets, and the Clippers as possible sellers. Each story is attributed and framed as a rumor. Open with the biggest clash, give two or three real facts per story, and end with a recap and a pick-a-side question.

long_videos.title_idea: Luka, the Ejected Fan, and the Week's Biggest Beefs
long_videos.angle: Beef shape. Lead with the Luka Doncic and ejected Kings fan incident and his wife's side of the story, then Giannis vs Nick Young and Doc Rivers, the announcer vs Ayesha Curry backlash, and the Porzingis locker cleanout reaction. Show where the outlets disagree, and give her take on each. Close with Steph Curry and the Warriors' win streak as the viral payoff.

shorts_themes: Beef and call-outs: Luka and the ejected fan, Giannis vs Nick Young, the announcer vs Ayesha Curry backlash
Trade rumor clue chains: Towns and the Knicks, Sabonis and the Kings, Jamal Murray and the Nuggets, Clippers as possible sellers
Viral performances: Steph Curry and the Warriors' win streak and clutch overtime history
Injury and roster news told as stakes: Anthony Davis and the Lakers reunion gossip, Ja Morant, Porzingis and the Warriors locker, Jalen Johnson's return
Offbeat off-court stories: LeBron stalking arrest report, Tyler Kolek and the Taylor Swift comment, Robert Williams and the Lakers official
Fan-reaction takes: where the fans picked a side, ending on a pick-a-side question
series: Rumor Clue Chain: 2 to 3 real facts, then 'Now why would they do that?'
Pick a Side: one beef, two sides, one question for the comments
Receipts: the exact attributed report behind a rumor, and what it changes
experiments: Test clash-first hooks naming both people against single-name hooks on beef Shorts
